assessment: Payload is not a physical DB measurement, but it credibly understates rather than proves storage fit: membership text alone exceeds configured headroom, and99.49% of modeled membership tuples fall below normal2KiB TOAST threshold. Do not assume archive/gzip/network compression makes TEXT tables small. Current full snapshot release representation is unlikely to fit512MiB budget.
assumptions: Text storage from postgres/schema.sql; short/ordinary field headers1/4bytes, aligned24byte tuple header+4byte line pointer, activeBIGINT; crude heap packing95% and B-tree leaf fill90%, no WAL/memory/provider accounting
Model does not claim exact TOAST compression, B-tree suffix truncation/dedup, existing page free space, heap bloat, alignment between individualfields or indexinternalpage overhead
Membership fields add release_id and remove transport-onlykind before modeling; max84,396/84,831 below2048model rows do not justify assuming TOAST storage

Source/archive media bodies go to R2, not database; existing preflight148,085,814 registered media bytes are NOT included as binary content in481MB DB. New R2 evidence still adds small metadata/ingestion rows and needs separatehosting limits
safest_gate: Re-read existing /api/storage/capacity and /api/storage/v2/export-marker before import. No SQL writes under this assessment.
Measure physical per-table/TOAST/index stats with authorized existing read-only runtime/admin database path; no new arbitrary-SQL API
Verify actual Neon project-plan storage capacity before committing to staged imports. The env budget is a guardrail, not providerquota, and changing it alone creates no capacity
If verified budget/headroom cannot accommodate realistic growth plusmargin, preserve ready offlinecandidate and report publicationblocked; do not write80krows then discoverbudget exhaustion
No repartitioning/compaction/R2database migration implemented here. Those belong to separately authorized engineering storage work.
sql_read_only: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows,pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_main_bytes,pg_table_size(c.oid) AS heap_and_toast_bytes,pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS index_bytes,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('atlas_geographic_memberships','atlas_geographic_changes','atlas_entities','atlas_ingestions','atlas_sources','atlas_geographic_releases') ORDER BY c.relname;

SELECT release_id,count(*) AS rows,sum(octet_length(evidence)) AS uncompressed_evidence_bytes,sum(pg_column_size(evidence)) AS evidence_stored_datum_bytes,avg(pg_column_size(evidence)) AS average_evidence_datum_bytes FROM atlas_geographic_memberships GROUP BY release_id ORDER BY release_id;
SELECT indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('atlas_geographic_memberships','atlas_geographic_changes');
